executive_summary.text: Cost year 2022: laundry cost per resident day ($9.38) was 180% of the Connecticut median ($5.21). Ask what drove the higher laundry cost (contracts, supplies, staffing or a one-time expense).
Cost year 2022: direct care cost was $204.71 per resident day (49.7% of expenses); Connecticut median $160.73.
Cost year 2022: nursing home operating margin was -13.7% (Connecticut median -0.4%).
Cost year 2022: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $2,171,199, 35.9% of the $6,050,085 direct care cost.

Cost year 2022: dietary cost $758,253, $25.66 per resident day (Connecticut median $28.39). Wages $348,960 (46.0%), allocated fringe $121,913 (16.1%), non-wage costs $287,380 (37.9%). Raw food was $221,875 ($7.51 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.24) and purchased dietary services $26,057.
Cost year 2022: housekeeping cost $280,335, $9.49 per resident day (Connecticut median $11.33). Wages $0 (0.0%), allocated fringe $0 (0.0%), non-wage costs $280,335 (100.0%).

Missing data: cost years 2016, 2018 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data); CCN not in the current CMS Provider Information release (closed, merged or not yet listed).

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
